observable_state_rules.observed: The observable prerequisite is established and at least one applicable facet is observed.
observable_state_rules.insufficient: The observable may apply but the prerequisite or all applicable facet distinctions lack sufficient evidence.
observable_state_rules.not_applicable: The observable prerequisite is affirmatively established as absent in the bounded response scope.

facet_state_rules.observed: At least one allowed value assertion is supported in this facet group at its declared cardinality scope.
facet_state_rules.insufficient: The facet is applicable at the declared cardinality scope but no allowed value can be supported without inference.
facet_state_rules.not_applicable: A facet-specific prerequisite is affirmatively absent at the declared cardinality scope.

response_state_scope.empty_assertion_rule: A facet_group or event_stage whose state is insufficient or not_applicable contains no substantive value assertions.
response_state_scope.nonmention_rule: Non-mention, unknown content, transcript silence, or an incomplete evidence frame yields insufficient, never not_applicable or established nonoccurrence.

rules: One observable_response may contain one or more facet_groups, including repeated facet_ids only when their cardinality_scope identities differ.
No global value_relation field is permitted.

Every contained_record_collections key names a required direct child array of this observable_response, and that array is the sole normative storage location for its declared record_type within this response.
Every item in a contained record collection conforms to the corresponding record_model or relation_model definition.

Each non-null id_field value is unique within its declared collection; every typed ID reference resolves to exactly one record in the named collection of this same observable_response, so dangling, duplicate, ambiguous, and cross-response references are invalid.

A record's containment in source_provenance_records does not make it evidence for any other record; each stage, window, edge, assertion, component, and absence condition names its own exact source_provenance_ids.

bidirectional_consistency_rules: Every contained value_assertion.assertion_id occurs in exactly one facet_group.assertion_ids list and exactly one event_stage.assertion_ids list; those records equal its facet_group_id and event_stage_id, and its evidence_unit_id equals that event_stage.evidence_unit_id.

Every contained component_assertion.component_assertion_id occurs in exactly one event_stage.component_assertion_ids list; that stage equals its event_stage_id, and its evidence_unit_id equals both the stage's evidence_unit_id and the evidence unit that contains that stage.

A component_assertion_id occurs in at most one value_assertion.component_assertion_ids list. When it occurs, that value_assertion is its selected hybrid parent: parent_value_id equals value_assertion.value_id, facet_id and facet_group_id equal the parent's fields, and event_stage_id and evidence_unit_id equal the parent's fields.

When a hybrid parent is not selected because one required component is insufficient, its retained component_assertions occur in no value_assertion.component_assertion_ids list; each remains bound without an independent occurrence count by parent_value_id, facet_id, facet_group_id, event_stage_id, evidence_unit_id, and the unique event_stage.component_assertion_ids back-reference.

Every absence_condition is referenced by exactly one component_assertion.absence_condition_id; its qualified_component_id names that same absence component, and qualified_assertion_id names the selected parent value_assertion or is null when the hybrid parent is not selected.

When absence_condition.qualified_assertion_id is non-null, that assertion contains qualified_component_id and has the same value_id, facet_id, facet_group_id, event_stage_id, and evidence_unit_id as the qualified component's parent and bindings.
Every contained event_stage.event_stage_id occurs in exactly one evidence_unit.event_stage_ids list, and that evidence unit's evidence_unit_id equals the event_stage.evidence_unit_id.

No value_assertion, component_assertion, or absence_condition gains an evidence occurrence from containment, parentage, component status, provenance count, or label count; occurrence support remains determined solely by its bound event_stage and evidence_unit.

rules: One facet_group instance represents one facet within exactly one cardinality_scope; cardinality never ranges over the whole observable_response.
facet_group_id is unique within the observable_response, including when the same facet_id appears in later scopes.
The facet_id, cardinality, cardinality_scope.scope_type, and any required measurement-window kind must match the bound observable facet profile.
For an event_stage scope, cardinality_scope.event_stage_id references exactly one event_stage and every assertion in the facet_group references that event_stage.

For a measurement_window scope, cardinality_scope.window_id references exactly one measurement_window of the profile-declared window_kind and every assertion's event_stage_id is listed in that window's event_stage_ids.
zero_or_one permits at most one observed substantive value_assertion in that facet_group; zero_one_or_multiple permits more than one only under the profile and codebook rules.
A later event_stage or later measurement_window may contain another facet_group with the same facet_id; sourced temporal edges order the scopes only when order is established.

Multiple values in one facet_group require distinct sourced components, distinct event_stages contained in its measurement_window scope, or an explicit multiple-copresence rule in the codebook overlay.
The same sourced facet fact may not be duplicated across facet_groups; same-act cross-facet assertions remain allowed but share one event_stage and evidence_unit.
Cross-facet assertions may be co-present without being placed in a temporal sequence.
A measurement_window is a source-bounded opportunity, interval, assessment, or follow-up window required by the codebook overlay; it is not inferred from array position.
window_kind selects an already accepted codebook scope rule; it is not a behavioral value, does not create a new distinction, and creates no evidence unit.
source_provenance_ids are the exact source set establishing the window identity and boundary facts available to the coding task.

event_stage_ids lists only stages inside or source-established boundary stages of the named window; membership does not itself establish temporal order, and a window with established nonoccurrence may contain no affirmative act stage.
Different window_ids are required for distinct later windows; temporal order between their stages is represented only by sourced temporal_edges.
A window created only to evade a zero_or_one cardinality limit is invalid.
One event_stage represents one bounded act, utterance, decision, or meaningful status transition.
All source_provenance_ids form the exact source set supporting the event_stage boundary and content.
Assertions on the same event_stage are co-present unless a separate event_stage and temporal edge is supplied.
Several facet labels on one event_stage do not create several behavioral events.
Every observed assertion has a nonempty exact source provenance set.
Every assertion binds to exactly one facet_group, one event_stage, and the same evidence_unit_id used by that event_stage.
Every assertion_id appears in exactly one facet_group.assertion_ids list and exactly one event_stage.assertion_ids list.
The bound facet_group has the same facet_id and a cardinality scope containing that event_stage.
A hybrid parent value is observed only when every required component_assertion is observed.
An observed affirmative component may be retained when its paired absence component is insufficient, but the hybrid parent value is then not selected.
An absence-dependent value with no established absence condition is not an observed parent assertion.
An affirmative component is observed only from positive report content and never from failure to mention an alternative action.
An absence component is observed only when absence_condition_id names a fully established gate for that exact component.
absence_condition_id is null for an affirmative component and required for an absence component.
An insufficient component carries no substantive proposition assertion but may retain missingness and uncertainty at its event_stage.
Component-level state preserves observed affirmative behavior even when the full hybrid parent value cannot be selected.

Every component_assertion binds to exactly one facet_group, one event_stage, and the same evidence_unit_id used by that event_stage; its parent_value_id is allowed by that facet_group and its facet_id matches the facet_group.

Every component_assertion_id appears in exactly one event_stage.component_assertion_ids list and in at most one value_assertion.component_assertion_ids list, under the bidirectional consistency rules.
A component_assertion is never an independent occurrence count; it inherits the one occurrence identity of its event_stage and evidence_unit whether or not the full hybrid parent is selected.
All four gate fields must be established before the qualified absence component is observed.
window_id references the exact measurement_window used for that absence claim.
The source_provenance_ids are the exact source set for the named absence target, window, and gate facts.
A gate cannot be reused for a different absent proposition, actor, or window.
Missing or partial reporting cannot set established_nonoccurrence to established.

qualified_component_id resolves to the one absence component whose absence_condition_id points back to this record; that component supplies the condition's unique facet_group, event_stage, and evidence_unit binding.

qualified_assertion_id resolves to that component's selected parent value_assertion or is null when the hybrid parent is not selected; a null value is not a record ID and creates no dangling reference.
Every cited source_record_id must belong to the supplied coding task.
An event_stage and each assertion/component carry their own exact provenance set; one set is not silently inherited as proof of a different claim.
Summary or orientation text cannot replace exact primary-source provenance.
All labels derived from one act, utterance, choice, terminal course, or endpoint trajectory share an evidence unit unless a genuinely new opportunity is established.
Specificity, extra facets, extra labels, scoped facet_groups, and derived trajectories never increase the independent evidence count.
Repeated-series self-report and self-selected examples follow the recurrence-v2 evidence firewall.
Temporal edges form an acyclic partial order.
An edge is added only when order is established by exact source evidence.
No edge is created merely from array position, window membership, or cross-facet co-presence.
Unknown order remains unrepresented and may carry an uncertainty flag.

copresence.representation: Assertions that reference the same event_stage_id are co-present.
rules: Co-presence is compatible with different facet_ids and different facet_group_ids.
Co-presence never implies simultaneity finer than the event_stage boundary and never implies temporal order.
Co-present assertions use the same evidence_unit_id.

specificity_and_precedence.default_rule: Within one facet and one declared cardinality scope, retain the narrowest supported value and suppress any broad value that adds no distinct sourced fact.
specificity_and_precedence.cumulative_rule: Broad and narrow values may both be asserted only for different sourced components or different event_stages or measurement_windows; assertions from the same behavioral occurrence still share one evidence unit.
specificity_and_precedence.composite_rule: A composite trajectory is represented by component assertions and temporal edges. If a retained derived label is displayed, its specificity_disposition is derived_not_countable and it creates no evidence unit.
specificity_and_precedence.uncertain_boundary_rule: If the required event-stage or measurement-window boundary fact is not established, the affected facet is insufficient; the coder does not split a scope or select among competing values by intuition.

R05-O2.affirmative: acceptance or selection of an existing option or designated default
R05-O2.absence: no additional alternative search during the named feasible preselection search opportunity

R07-i.absence: no transition to focal action during the named feasible observed period

R15-b.absence: no completion by the defined due point or condition

R15-c.affirmative: completion of one or more named endpoint components
R15-c.absence: noncompletion of one or more other named endpoint components during the assessment window

R16-c.absence: no request during the named feasible pre-prompt request opportunity

R16-d2.absence: no direct help request during the named feasible request window

R16-f.absence: no use of the accepted help during the named feasible use window

R18-d.affirmative: communication of a named subset of the relevant condition
R18-d.absence: no communication of a named remaining part during a sufficiently observed feasible communication opportunity

R18-f.absence: no communication of the named condition during the defined feasible preconsequence window

R20-j.affirmative: repetition of the narrator's previously stated position
R20-j.absence: no address, answer, or other engagement with the other party's identified content during the defined exchange

R21-f.absence: no discussion of the recognized rupture during the relevant resumed-contact interaction or named feasible discussion opportunity

R21-i.absence: no repair action during the initial named feasible repair window

default_observable_profile.applies_to: Any codebook observable without a more specific profile below.

substantive_response.value_ids_source: The allowed values in the bound versioned codebook.

rules: Co-present assertions attach to one event_stage; sourced sequential actions use separate event_stages, facet_groups, and temporal edges.
The global invariants, evidence-unit rule, specificity rule, and exact absence-condition rule apply unchanged.

NBM-R02.scope_rule: R02-f and R02-g remain exclusive for one search-termination decision stage; a distinct later forgoing decision uses a new event_stage-scoped facet_group and is ordered only when sourced.

NBM-R03.scope_rule: R03-c and R03-h remain exclusive within one action_window; a later R03-h requires a distinct later action_window after the revisit point and a separate window-scoped facet_group.

choice_resolution.multiple_rule: Multiple resolution values require distinct sourced components within the stage; ordered resolution stages use distinct event_stage-scoped facet_groups under the codebook precedence rules.

NBM-R10.scope_rule: Schedule alternatives remain exclusive within one allocation_interval; a changed schedule requires a distinct later allocation_interval and separate window-scoped facet_group, with temporal order only when sourced.

later_goal_status.multiple_rule: Multiple values in one stage require distinct status components; G6 and G7 require distinct stop and follow-up stages and therefore distinct event_stage-scoped facet_groups.

NBM-R12.scope_rule: Structural alternatives remain exclusive for one bounded later-attempt stage; a successive attempt uses a new event_stage-scoped facet_group and is ordered only when sourced.

NBM-R15.scope_rule: Endpoint extent alternatives remain exclusive within one endpoint_assessment_window; an earlier partial or noncompletion assessment and a later completion assessment use distinct window-scoped facet_groups while remaining one evidence unit when they belong to one endpoint trajectory.

NBM-R16.scope_rule: Offer/use alternatives remain exclusive within one offer_use_window; different offers or a later reversal require distinct window-scoped facet_groups and ordered stages only when sourced.

NBM-R20.scope_rule: R20-g and R20-h remain exclusive for one dialogue turn; a later change in interaction disposition uses a new event_stage-scoped facet_group and is ordered only when sourced.

NBM-R21.scope_rule: R21-f and R21-j remain exclusive for one contact event; resumption followed by later withdrawal or contact-ending uses distinct event_stage-scoped facet_groups and sourced temporal edges.

invariants.rule: Every observed value assertion binds to one facet, one facet_group, one event_stage, one evidence unit, and a nonempty exact source provenance set.
No observable-level global relation may impose one order on all selected values.
Temporal order exists only as sourced edges between event_stage identities and must be acyclic.
Assertions on one event_stage are co-present; array order and shared window membership have no temporal meaning.
All assertions derived from the same behavioral act or trajectory share one evidence unit and count at most once as occurrence support.
Specificity and number of facet labels or facet_groups never establish independence.
Every absence condition names exactly one absent actor, proposition, and window; all four gate elements must be established from exact provenance.
Unknown, not reported, transcript silence, or a partial evidence frame cannot establish nonoccurrence.
A more specific value suppresses a broad value for the same facet fact unless distinct sourced components or scopes are represented.
A derived or composite trajectory creates no evidence unit beyond its component events.
An insufficient or not_applicable scope contains no substantive value assertion.
Not_applicable requires affirmative absence of the relevant prerequisite; non-mention is insufficient.
Historical v1, v2, v3, and v4 records are never reinterpreted in place; v5 responses use new schema identity and explicit source-version bindings.

The contract is compatible with theory-blind human and automated coding because both receive the same codebook overlay, facet profile, exact evidence, precedence rules, scoped cardinality, and absence gates while remaining label-isolated.
Every facet_group cardinality is evaluated only within its declared event_stage or measurement_window scope, never across the whole response.
A later same-facet assertion requires a distinct sourced event_stage or measurement_window and a distinct facet_group; a new group may not be invented to bypass same-scope exclusivity.
The same sourced facet fact cannot be duplicated across facet_groups or counted twice; co-present different facets remain allowed and share the event_stage evidence unit.
Distinct scopes do not imply order; only exact-source temporal_edges order their event_stages.

Every value_assertion, component_assertion, absence_condition, and source_provenance record is stored in its required observable_response collection, and every typed ID reference resolves exactly once within that same response.
Every component_assertion binds to exactly one event_stage and that stage's one evidence_unit through matching direct fields and an exactly-one event_stage back-reference.

A component belongs to at most one selected hybrid parent assertion; a retained component whose hybrid parent is not selected remains uniquely attached to its parent value, facet_group, event_stage, and evidence_unit and never becomes an independent occurrence.

Every absence_condition is owned by exactly one absence component and follows that component's parent, stage, and evidence-unit binding; its parent assertion reference is exact when selected and null when the parent is not selected.

Contained provenance is not globally inherited: every referencing record names its own exact source_provenance_ids, and sharing a provenance record implies support only for each record that explicitly cites it.

blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-007: NBM-R02 applies search-disposition exclusivity per search-termination decision event_stage, allowing a distinct later forgoing stage without response-wide rejection.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-011: NBM-R03 applies temporal-disposition exclusivity per action_window, allowing an ordered later-window R03-h only under the overlay's revisit and absence conditions.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-029: NBM-R05 can place option-construction or search-disposition assertions on an event_stage while the R05-O2 absence component retains its named preselection window; separate resolution stages preserve a partial order and no false cross-facet order is created.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-034: NBM-R07 preparation-type assertions may be co-present on one preparation stage, while a later R07-i transition-status stage is temporally ordered and carries its own absence condition.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-076: NBM-R15 applies endpoint extent/timing cardinality per endpoint_assessment_window, so distinct stages of one endpoint trajectory remain representable without creating independent evidence.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-084: NBM-R15 permits an earlier partial or noncompletion assessment and a later completion assessment in distinct windows while preserving one trajectory evidence unit.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-085: NBM-R16 applies offer response/use exclusivity per offer_use_window; request and offer stages preserve chronology while help type, source breadth, and use assertions attach co-presently to the relevant stage.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-114: NBM-R20 stores each dialogue turn as an event_stage, applies interaction-disposition exclusivity per turn, permits content and escalation assertions on one turn, and orders only sourced turns.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.OA-121: NBM-R21 stores co-present repair content, origin, and channel on a repair event while allowing distinct ordered contact-disposition stages for resumption and later withdrawal.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.NR-001: Every default and observable-specific facet now declares event_stage or measurement_window cardinality scope; R10 schedule changes and R12 successive structures use distinct scoped facet_groups, and no facet cardinality ranges over the whole response.
blocking_contract_finding_representation.NR2-001: The observable_response now directly contains all value_assertion, component_assertion, absence_condition, and source_provenance records; typed references resolve exactly once within the response, every component binds uniquely to one event_stage and its evidence_unit, and hybrid parent/child and provenance ownership remain explicit without adding occurrence counts.
